1.explanation:
1. RadioButton/RadioButton.mdx – The primary component doc showing existing props, examples, and placeholders where a new `readonly` prop and its styling notes belong.
2. RadioButton/docs/overview.mdx – Design guidelines for the RadioButton, including color tokens and spacing rules that must be mirrored for the read-only variant.
3. RadioButton/migrate-to-7.x.md – Migration notes around breaking changes; useful for understanding how adding a new prop may affect downstream consumers.
4. RadioButtonGroup/RadioButtonGroup.mdx – The grouping wrapper doc, which must account for read-only layout (vertical vs. horizontal) and spacing between items.
5. RadioButtonGroup/docs/overview.mdx – Explains group-level API and spacing specs; necessary to reproduce the vertical/horizontal spacing shown in the second image.

Together these documents cover the component API, design tokens, layout specs, grouping behavior, and migration considerations needed to implement, validate, and document the new read-only state.
1.bug_scenario:
The bug report describes implementing a new “read-only” variant of the RadioButton component in the React package. The two design images show:

• Color & typography for unselected vs. selected read-only radio items (icon-disabled and text-placeholder when unselected; icon-primary and text-primary when selected; secondary text color on a grouped label).
• Vertical/horizontal layout specs for read-only groups: 20px top/bottom padding, 8px gutter between icon and label, and 16px spacing between items in a horizontal group.

The goal is to add a `readonly` prop to RadioButton, apply these styles, update the playground with controls for each state, add a default story, and write RTL tests to verify the read-only CSS class is applied.
